constraints: Legacy standard-action constants prefixed '_o_' in the "Standard Action" theme are deprecated since 4D v16 R3 but still supported for compatibility.

params.name: action
params.description: Name of the standard action (or a Standard Action theme constant), optionally with parameters.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Associates or replaces the standard action bound to the designated form object.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
